items.desc: US envoy says Hezbollah must disarm 'voluntarily' Hezbollah must "voluntarily" lay down its arms, US Ambassador to the UN Mike Waltz stated on Monday during a visit to Lebanon, adding that there cannot be "two armies" in the country. items.title: Jordan bans Telegram, accusing it of promoting 'extremism'
items.desc: Jordan bans Telegram, accusing it of promoting 'extremism' Jordan announced a ban on the Telegram network on Monday, accusing it of contributing to the spread of "extremism" within the kingdom. "We are announcing the blocking of the Telegram application as part of efforts to strengthen digital security and protect users," the Public Security Directorate stated in a press release. The move is intended to prevent "cybercrimes, threats, blackmail, and the dissemination of illegal content", as well as to counter "any attempt to spread radicalisation and extremism".

items.title: Report: Netanyahu's allies open to unity government without Ben Gvir’s party
items.desc: Report: Netanyahu's allies open to unity government without Ben Gvir’s party Associates of Benjamin Netanyahu have told Yashar party leader Gadi Eisenkot’s team they would accept a unity government without National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir's party, according to the daily Israel Hayom. Netanyahu’s associates said that Likud could let go of Otzma Yehudit (Jewish Power) if negotiations opened on a broad coalition. They also told figures in Eisenkot’s bloc that Washington was demanding Otzma Yehudit's exclusion. However, Likud has denied conveying such messages.

items.title: US embassy in Bahrain urges Americans to exercise 'heightened vigilance'
items.desc: US embassy in Bahrain urges Americans to exercise 'heightened vigilance' The US embassy in Bahrain urged its citizens on Sunday to exercise "heightened vigilance" amid escalating regional instability. "Americans in Bahrain should exercise heightened vigilance due to the increased threat of armed attacks by Iranian-supported Houthis and Iranian efforts to target U.S. government officials and facilities in the region," it said in a statement, urging citizens to be aware of potential alerts and travel disruptions.

items.desc: Israeli military jeep runs over Palestinians in occupied West Bank The Palestine Red Crescent Society said that two Palestinians were left wounded after being run over by an Israeli military jeep near Jenin in the northern occupied West Bank.
